question: The average of 19 numbers is 48. The average of the first 7 numbers is 50.6 and that of the last 13 numbers is 47.6. If the 7th number is excluded, then what is the average of the remaining numbers (correct to one decimal place)?
solution:
**Given:**

The average of 19 numbers = 48

The average of the first 7 numbers = 50.6

The average of last 13 numbers = 47.6

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

The average of 19 numbers = (19 × 48) = 912

The average of the first 7 numbers = (7 × 50.6) = 354.2

The average of last 13 numbers = (13 × 47.6) = 618.8

Now,

7th number = (618.8 + 354.2 – 912)

⇒ (973 – 912)

⇒ 61

Sum of remaining 18 numbers = (912 – 61) = 851

The average of the remaining numbers = (851/18)

⇒ 47.3

**∴ The required average is 47.3**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Let a₁, a₂......a₁₉ are the number

⇒ a₁ + a₂ + ...a₁₉ = (19 × 48) = 912 ----(1)

⇒ a1 + a2 + ...a₇ = (7 × 50.6) = 354.2 ----(2)

⇒ a₇ + a₈ + ...a₁₉ = (13 × 47.6) = 618.8 ----(3)

Adding equation (2) and (3)

⇒ a₁ + a₂ + ..a₇ + a₇ + .....a₁₉ = 354.2 + 618.8 = 973

⇒ a₇ + a₁ + a₂ + .....a19 = 973

⇒ a₇ + 912= 973 [From (1)]

⇒ a7 = 61

Hecne new sum = 912 - 61 = 851

**∴ New average = 851/18 = 47.3**
